sezioni.heading: Why choose DTF printing
paragrafi: DTF (Direct To Film) printing transfers your artwork onto the fabric using a film and a heat press. The result is rich, full colours and gradients with no colour limits and no surcharge, even for complex logos.

It works on cotton, polyester, blended and technical fabrics, whether light or dark. With the right care (wash inside out at low temperatures, and never iron directly over the print) it easily withstands dozens of washes.

Want to become a partner or get a tailored quote? Get in touch for a free consultation.

faq.domanda: What is DTF printing and how does it work?
faq.risposta: DTF stands for Direct To Film. The artwork is printed onto a special film, coated with adhesive powder and transferred onto the fabric with a heat press. The result is vivid colours and sharp detail on almost any fabric.

faq.domanda: How much does DTF printing by the metre cost?
faq.risposta: Our price is CHF 25.00 per linear metre plus VAT, with a minimum order of 1 metre. For orders from 5 linear metres we apply dedicated discounts.

faq.domanda: How well does a DTF print hold up to washing?
faq.risposta: With the right care, a DTF print withstands dozens of washes while keeping its colours and definition. We recommend washing the garment inside out at low temperatures and never ironing directly over the print.

faq.domanda: Which fabrics can it be applied to?
faq.risposta: DTF works on cotton, polyester, blended and technical fabrics, whether light or dark. It's not recommended on very stretchy or waterproof materials such as softshell, neoprene and pure elastane.

faq.domanda: How should I prepare the file for printing?
faq.risposta: You'll need a print-ready vector file with a fixed height of 36 cm. If you're unsure about the format, we can check it together before going ahead with the order.
